objective: Respect the P7-to-P8 gate; do not finalize technical design before the PRD is approved.
scenario: The user asks for architecture while core user problem, product requirements and operator ownership remain provisional.
expected_behaviors: Explain P8 is provisional or deferred until P7 approval.
Offer bounded option analysis or a technical spike, not a falsely approved design.
Identify security/privacy, failure, operations, accessibility and integration constraints.
prohibited_behaviors: Mark P8 complete or design approved while P7 is incomplete.
